http/internal/websocket_output#

The single writer of a WebSocket connection: messages cut into frames, control frames between them, each message finished once started.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The single writer of a WebSocket connection: messages cut into frames, control frames between them, each message finished once started.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object WebSocketOutput#

object WebSocketOutput

Exactly one writer owns the wire. Started messages finish all fragments even when a caller abandons its ticket; connection abort cancels physical writing.
